Edinburgh [ a ] is the capital city of Scotland and one of its 32 council areas . It is located in southeast Scotland and is bounded to the north by the Firth of Forth and to the south by the Pentland Hills . Edinburgh had a population of
506,520 in 2020, [ 6 ] making it the second-most-populous city in Scotland and the seventh-most-populous in the United Kingdom . The wider metropolitan area had a population of 912,490 in the same year. [ 7 ]
